name: DX NetOps Spectrum
description: Atomic CRUD workflows for the DX NetOps Spectrum OneClick Web Services API, one per curated operation in dx_netops_spectrum-latest.json.

document.name: Issue an action against the SpectroSERVER
document.description: Issues an action request to the SpectroSERVER, identified by an internal action code, optionally targeted at a model and passed attribute-value input pairs.

0001.name: getAction
0001.summary: Issue an action against the SpectroSERVER
0001.description: Issues an action request to the SpectroSERVER, identified by an internal action code, optionally targeted at a model and passed attribute-value input pairs.

actionCode.description: Hex action code (e.g. 0x10093) identifying the action to perform.

mh.description: Model handle the action is performed against.

attr.description: Attribute ID for an input attribute-value pair passed to the action.

val.description: Value for the attribute identified by `attr`.

throttlesize.description: Maximum number of results to return per response page.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: List alarms
document.description: Returns alarms, optionally scoped by attribute, landscape, or a page size limit.

0002.name: listAlarms
0002.description: Returns alarms, optionally scoped by attribute, landscape, or a page size limit.

attr.description: Attribute ID to include in the returned alarm data.

landscape.description: Landscape handle to scope the alarm query to.

throttlesize.description: Maximum number of alarms to return per response page.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Query alarms by XML search criteria
document.description: GET-tunneling endpoint for advanced alarm queries: retrieves alarms matching an XML document that specifies alarm IDs, model handles, or search criteria too complex for query parameters.

0003.name: queryAlarms
0003.summary: Query alarms by XML search criteria
0003.description: GET-tunneling endpoint for advanced alarm queries: retrieves alarms matching an XML document that specifies alarm IDs, model handles, or search criteria too complex for query parameters.

body.description: XML document specifying the alarms to retrieve, by alarm ID, model handle list, or search criteria.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Get alarm counts by severity
document.description: Returns alarm counts by severity (critical, major, minor, and so on) for the alarms matching the supplied XML filter criteria.

0004.name: getAlarmCount
0004.description: Returns alarm counts by severity (critical, major, minor, and so on) for the alarms matching the supplied XML filter criteria.

body.description: XML document specifying alarm filter criteria, for example a named alarm filter (`<rs:alarm-filter name="..."/>`).

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: List available alarm filters
document.description: Returns the alarm filters defined on the OneClick server that can be referenced by name when querying alarms.

0005.name: getAlarmFilters
0005.description: Returns the alarm filters defined on the OneClick server that can be referenced by name when querying alarms.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Update or acknowledge an alarm
document.description: Updates an attribute on an alarm (for example, acknowledging it) by setting an attribute ID/value pair on the alarm identified by its alarm ID.

0006.name: updateAlarmAttribute
0006.description: Updates an attribute on an alarm (for example, acknowledging it) by setting an attribute ID/value pair on the alarm identified by its alarm ID.

attr.description: Attribute ID to set on the alarm.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Clear an alarm
document.description: Clears (deletes) a single alarm identified by its alarm ID.

0007.name: deleteAlarm
0007.description: Clears (deletes) a single alarm identified by its alarm ID.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Create an association between two models
document.description: Creates an association of the given relation type between a left and a right model.

0008.name: createAssociation
0008.summary: Create an association between two models
0008.description: Creates an association of the given relation type between a left and a right model.

relationType.description: Relation type name for the new association.

leftModelHandle.description: Model handle of the left-side model.

rightModelHandle.description: Model handle of the right-side model.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Delete an association between two models
document.description: Deletes an existing association of the given relation type between a left and a right model.

0009.name: deleteAssociation
0009.summary: Delete an association between two models
0009.description: Deletes an existing association of the given relation type between a left and a right model.

relationType.description: Relation type name of the association to remove.

leftModelHandle.description: Model handle of the left-side model.

rightModelHandle.description: Model handle of the right-side model.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Get a model's associations
document.description: Returns the models associated with the given model through the specified relation type.

000a.name: getAssociations
000a.description: Returns the models associated with the given model through the specified relation type.

relationType.description: Relation type name (for example, a containment or connection relation).

modelHandle.description: Model handle to look up associations for.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Get an attribute's enumeration values
document.description: Returns the valid enumeration (name/value) pairs for an enumerated attribute type.

000b.name: getAttributeEnums
000b.description: Returns the valid enumeration (name/value) pairs for an enumerated attribute type.

attrId.description: Hex attribute ID (for example, 0x1000a) of the enumerated attribute.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Get a model's connectivity
document.description: Returns the connection information (ports, links) for the given device model.

000c.name: getConnectivity
000c.description: Returns the connection information (ports, links) for the given device model.

modelHandle.description: Model handle of the device to look up connectivity for.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: List devices
document.description: Returns the devices currently modeled on the OneClick server.

000d.name: listDevices
000d.description: Returns the devices currently modeled on the OneClick server.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Create an event
document.description: Creates an event on the OneClick server from an XML event document.

000e.name: createEvent
000e.description: Creates an event on the OneClick server from an XML event document.

body.description: XML document describing the event to create, including its event type and attribute values.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Query events by XML search criteria
document.description: Retrieves events matching an XML document that specifies event IDs, model handles, or search criteria.

000f.name: queryEvents
000f.summary: Query events by XML search criteria
000f.description: Retrieves events matching an XML document that specifies event IDs, model handles, or search criteria.

body.description: XML document specifying the events to retrieve.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Create an event against a specific model
document.description: Creates an event on the given model within the given landscape, from an XML event document.

0010.name: createEventForModel
0010.summary: Create an event against a specific model
0010.description: Creates an event on the given model within the given landscape, from an XML event document.

landscapeHandle.description: Landscape handle the target model belongs to.

modelHandle.description: Model handle to raise the event against.

body.description: XML document describing the event to create, including its event type and attribute values.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: List landscapes
document.description: Returns the landscapes (SpectroSERVERs) known to the OneClick server.

0011.name: listLandscapes
0011.description: Returns the landscapes (SpectroSERVERs) known to the OneClick server.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Create a model
document.description: Creates a new model (for example, a device) from an XML document specifying its model type and initial attribute values.

0012.name: createModel
0012.description: Creates a new model (for example, a device) from an XML document specifying its model type and initial attribute values.

body.description: XML document specifying the new model's type and attribute values.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Bulk-update attributes across models by XML
document.description: Updates one or more attribute values across one or more models in a single call, from an XML document listing model handles and attribute values.

0013.name: bulkUpdateModelAttributes
0013.summary: Bulk-update attributes across models by XML
0013.description: Updates one or more attribute values across one or more models in a single call, from an XML document listing model handles and attribute values.

body.description: XML document listing the model handles and attribute values to update.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Get a model
document.description: Returns a model's attribute values by its model handle.

0014.name: getModel
0014.description: Returns a model's attribute values by its model handle.

attr.description: Attribute ID to include in the returned model data. Repeat to request multiple attributes.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Update a model's attributes
document.description: Updates one or more attribute values on the given model, supplied as attribute ID/value query parameters.

0015.name: updateModelAttributes
0015.description: Updates one or more attribute values on the given model, supplied as attribute ID/value query parameters.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Delete a model
document.description: Deletes the model identified by its model handle.

0016.name: deleteModel
0016.description: Deletes the model identified by its model handle.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Query models by XML search criteria
document.description: Retrieves models matching an XML search-criteria document, using the OneClick server's search infrastructure.

0017.name: queryModels
0017.summary: Query models by XML search criteria
0017.description: Retrieves models matching an XML search-criteria document, using the OneClick server's search infrastructure.

body.description: XML document specifying model search criteria, attribute list, and result options.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Bulk-update attributes across models by XML (models endpoint)
document.description: Updates attribute values across one or more models in a single call, from an XML document listing model handles and attribute values.

0018.name: bulkUpdateModelAttributesByXml
0018.summary: Bulk-update attributes across models by XML (models endpoint)
0018.description: Updates attribute values across one or more models in a single call, from an XML document listing model handles and attribute values.

body.description: XML document listing the model handles and attribute values to update.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Query all devices by XML search criteria
document.description: Retrieves all device models matching an XML search-criteria document, using the OneClick server's search infrastructure.

0019.name: queryAllDevices
0019.summary: Query all devices by XML search criteria
0019.description: Retrieves all device models matching an XML search-criteria document, using the OneClick server's search infrastructure.

body.description: XML document specifying device search criteria.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Create a notification subscription
document.description: Creates a subscription so the OneClick server pushes notifications (for example, alarm or model updates) to a listening client.

001a.name: createSubscription
001a.description: Creates a subscription so the OneClick server pushes notifications (for example, alarm or model updates) to a listening client.

body.description: XML document specifying the subscription's notification type, filter, and destination.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: List pending subscription requests
document.description: Returns notifications queued for pull-based subscriptions (as opposed to push-based delivery).

001b.name: listSubscriptionRequests
001b.description: Returns notifications queued for pull-based subscriptions (as opposed to push-based delivery).

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Get a subscription
document.description: Returns the details of a subscription by its subscription ID.

001c.name: getSubscription
001c.description: Returns the details of a subscription by its subscription ID.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).

document.name: Delete a subscription
document.description: Deletes a subscription by its subscription ID, stopping further pushed notifications.

001d.name: deleteSubscription
001d.description: Deletes a subscription by its subscription ID, stopping further pushed notifications.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}).
